name: The Hollow
summary: The Warden's own encounter cards: hounds, mist, and the roots under the hill.

goals: Roughly even split between threat pressure and bodies
One card that punishes upgrades, one that punishes wide tables
design.notes: 10 cards is small on purpose: at 4 players the deck cycles about every 2.5 rounds, which makes reshuffle behaviour easy to observe.
